entries.brief: One candid, realistic editorial photograph, wide horizontal composition. Natural human proportions, colors and texture; leave enough room to see what is moving and what it contacts. Broadside view, both pairs of boots and the water's edge visible, worn harbor wall, restrained overcast color.
